name: Codex 工作區
brief: Light workspace design, the closest conceptual match to Codex. Warm off-white left sidebar about 200 px with a compact workspace selector 黑板, search, 新建黑板, recent board entries, and account/settings at the bottom. Selected board title 專案構想. Main area is a very large white infinite dot canvas with a restrained top breadcrumb and stable 已儲存 indicator. A narrow rounded floating horizontal tool dock centered at the bottom includes T; right edge shows only a collapsed 屬性 bookmark, not an open inspector. Same sample board: heading 產品構想, a curved green line leading to a yellow note labelled 先畫，再整理, a simple triangle and one screenshot card. Show six to nine carefully grouped tool glyphs, secondary features in a small ellipsis. Calm and immediately understandable. Tiny unobtrusive concept marker 01 in upper right.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one highly polished, plausible native macOS interface concept for the user's drawing app HeiBan / 黑板. This is a design proposal, not a screenshot of an existing product. Flat front-on desktop app window, landscape 16:10, high resolution, crisp interface typography and icons, entire window visible, no laptop or device frame, no perspective, no photographic background. Include subtle macOS window traffic lights. Inspired by the quiet hierarchy of the Codex desktop app: neutral surfaces, generous spacing, thin separators, a concise project sidebar when appropriate, small restrained controls, clean system type, no glassy gimmicks or ornamental marketing. Use Traditional Chinese for short UI labels; prefer fewer readable labels to dense microtext. Main drawing tools must visibly include a literal Latin T, pen, eraser, simple shapes, sticky note, ruler, image and undo. Keep icons consistent. Most of the area must be usable canvas; avoid giant toolbars. Property inspector collapses behind a bookmark-like tab except where a selected shape genuinely needs its controls. Never show a half-width text editor or a scrollbar dividing an editor in the middle.
Use accurate visual samples of editable objects: green curved ink, a triangle with three editable vertex handles when selected, a translucent pale-yellow sticky note with concise readable text, one short text object, a simple screenshot image card, a visible pin. The design should support smooth native interaction. No invented AI chatbot, code editor, terminal, fake performance claims, huge banners, gradients, watermarks or logos of unrelated brands. Product title must be 黑板.

name: 專注畫布
brief: Canvas-first focus layout, visibly different from a persistent sidebar. Full-bleed pale warm white infinite dot canvas; leftmost slim rail with only home/library and account icons, no broad sidebar. A compact small top pill contains 專案構想, saved dot and zoom 100%. Drawing tools dock vertically along the left edge as one elegant slim column with pen, curve, eraser, ruler, shape, sticky and literal T. The right property inspector is fully collapsed as a small bookmark tab 屬性. Lower right has small zoom/pan controls. Canvas takes at least 88% of the window and shows the same illustrative objects: curved green stroke, triangle, yellow note 先畫，再整理, screenshot card and tiny pin. A small context popover next to the selected triangle offers outline color, thickness and opacity, only three rows, avoiding crowding. Tiny marker 02. Focused, modern, no ornament.

name: 筆記本
brief: Notebook layout for handwriting and mixed notes. Light native macOS UI. A quiet left sidebar contains notebooks and vertically stacked thumbnail pages, selected page 第 2 頁. Main workspace light-gray with one centered finite white A4 portrait sheet clearly separated by delicate shadow. On the paper are concise heading 會議筆記, short handwritten green curved annotation, one triangle, a pale-yellow sticky note labelled 下一步, and a small screenshot inserted beside text. Thin horizontal tool row directly above the paper containing pen, eraser, shape, ruler, T and sticky, with subtle stroke color/size options; it feels like native document editing. Right edge has collapsed 屬性 bookmark only. Bottom of left sidebar displays 新增頁面; page footer 2 / 4. Paper boundaries and small ruled lines are visible. Document chrome is compact and calm, at least 70% drawing area. Tiny marker 03.

name: 圖形工作台
brief: Precision drawing / editable vector shape workbench, elegant light native macOS UI. Narrow left vertical drawing tool column. Large warm white canvas in center, a slim useful right sidebar of about 210 px with tabs 屬性 and 圖層, active 屬性 because triangle is selected. Show a green outlined triangle with three clearly draggable vertex circles, one selected control point, small subtle rotation handle and one curved ink path with editable Bézier handles. Inspector contains real compact controls: 線條 with circular color swatch, 2.0 pt width, dashed line selector; 填色 with color swatch, opacity 60%; a small arrow size selector only in a collapsed section; below, a compact layer list with note, curve, triangle and screenshot rows. Bottom horizontal dock includes T, note, image, undo; top breadcrumb 專案構想 with saved status. A yellow sticky note and screenshot card remain on the board. High practical usability with space and no crowded ribbon. Tiny marker 04.

name: 首頁作品庫
brief: A polished light native macOS HOMEPAGE / board library rather than an editor. Codex-inspired warm neutral left sidebar with 黑板, 我的黑板, 最近開啟, 已釘選, 筆記本, and account/settings at bottom. Main content title 我的黑板, compact search field and button 新建. Across the top of the content are three small tasteful creation options 有邊界畫布, 無邊界畫布, 筆記本, each with a simple line icon. Below, a roomy grid of six board cards with genuine content thumbnails, never blank samples: a green brainstorm blackboard, a white diagram with triangle, handwritten notebook page, image annotated with curves, sticky note collection, and restrained plan board. Short board titles such as 專案構想, 會議筆記, 草圖. Each card has a small select checkbox and ellipsis menu supporting delete/pin. One card lightly selected, with unobtrusive selection actions. An account card at lower left shows 本機使用 and a modest 登入 Google button, visually presenting the future account entry without pretending sign-in was implemented. No marketing hero, no dozens of examples, no fake data-heavy dashboard. Tiny marker 06. Spacious, coherent thumbnail library.
